# MADGEN

> Madgen (https://madgen.us) — Systems for what's next. A digital foundry for automation, product and brand — built as one connected system.

## About

Madgen started in 2025 with a stubborn belief: small businesses deserve the same calibre of engineering and design that funded startups get. Today we're a full-stack digital partner — one team of 14 specialists handling the automation, the software, the site and the story, so nothing falls into the gaps between agencies. Remote-first, global. Average engagement: 3–9 months. We keep client rosters deliberately small — every project gets senior hands, not a rotating cast of juniors.

## Services

- [AI Automation](https://madgen.us/services/ai-automation): Custom workflows and AI agents that take repetitive work off your team's plate — workflow design, AI agents, and integrations.
- [Website Development](https://madgen.us/services/website-development): Fast, accessible, conversion-minded marketing sites, e-commerce, and CMS builds on modern stacks — designed to be edited without calling us every time.
- [App Development](https://madgen.us/services/app-development): iOS, Android and cross-platform products from first prototype through to something real users open every day — mobile apps, cross-platform, MVP builds.
- [Digital Marketing](https://madgen.us/services/digital-marketing): Paid, organic and lifecycle campaigns tied to real revenue targets — paid media, SEO, email & CRM.
- [Branding](https://madgen.us/services/branding): Identity systems — name, mark, voice and guidelines — built to hold up across a product, not just a pitch deck.

## Why Choose Madgen

- **Senior hands only**: You work directly with the people doing the work — no account-manager relay race.
- **One connected system**: Your site, app, automations and marketing are built to share data, not fight each other.
- **Fixed-scope pricing**: You know the number before we start. No surprise invoices, no scope creep tax.
- **We stay after launch**: Retainers built for iteration, not just handoff-and-disappear support tickets.

## Process

1. **Discover** (Week 1): We map the problem, the users and the constraints before opening a single design tool.
2. **Design** (Week 2–3): Wireframes to high-fidelity screens, reviewed together in short async loops — not one big reveal.
3. **Build** (Week 3–8): Engineering in weekly increments you can see and test, with staging links from day one.
4. **Launch** (Week 9): QA, performance passes and a staged rollout — launch day should be uneventful by design.
5. **Grow** (Ongoing): Post-launch retainer covering iteration, campaigns and the automations that keep compounding.
